summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, computer science background, avid gamer (especially Call of Duty and World of Warcraft), strong advocate for open source software, critical of corporate management practices, feminist views on gender roles in tech, supports diversity in STEM, skeptical of startup culture, values work-life balance, prefers working on meaningful projects over high-pressure environments, critical of educational systems and their impact on student performance, interested in programming languages and frameworks (Java, Scala, Python), engaged in discussions about technology ethics and societal impacts.
